changes: Employer, job title and work details no longer appear on a young child's profile. They show from the age someone can actually be employed where you live — 15 in Austria and South Africa, 13 in the UK, 14 in the US.

Choosing your own celebration date now has a "Help me work it out" option: it asks you two or three questions about what the day is attached to, then writes the title and the reason from your answers.

It will not invent a date. If your answers don't pin down a day, it says exactly what it still needs instead of quietly picking one that looks plausible — a date it chose would be indistinguishable from one you chose.
Everything it fills in stays editable, and nothing is saved until you press Save.
